The Karnataka Examinations Authority has released the KSP Constable result 2026 on 21st August at the official website. Applicants who appeared in the exam can now check their results at cetonline.karnataka.gov.in. The exam authority has also released the KSP Constable scorecard for all the candidates who appeared in the examination. The result is released separately for all the districts. Candidates shortlisted based on the performance in the test are eligible to appear for the Physical Endurance and Measurement test. Applicants will be required to carry all their documents along with xerox copies at the time of appearing in the physical test. Based on the KSP Constable result 2026, candidates called for the physical test are given time for the number of vacancies announced. Check the result PDF, detailed mention, steps to download, and other details here.

KSP Constable Result 2026 – Overview

The exam authority has announced on the official website for the written exam, which was conducted on 2nd August. Candidates can check the result overview information from the table provided below.

Karnataka Police Constable Physical Test

How to Download KSP Constable Result 2026?

Candidates can refer to the steps provided below to download the KSP Constable scorecard 2026.

  • Visit the KEA official website at cetonline.karnataka.gov.in.
  • From the homepage, click on the “Civil Police Constable Recruitment (RPC & KK) Provisional Result 2026” link.
  • Click on the result scorecard PDF for the respective district.
  • Check all the information mentioned in the scorecard PDF.
  • Download the KSP Constable result PDF for future reference.

Details mentioned in KSP Constable Result 2026

After downloading the scorecard PDF, applicants are advised to check all the details mentioned in it. Candidates can find the below-mentioned information from the Constable result PDF.

  • Post applied for
  • Application number
  • Candidate name
  • Category
  • Kannada Medium status
  • Gender
  • Registration number
  • Marks obtained

Documents Required for KSP Constable Physical Endurance Test 2026

Candidates who are shortlisted based on the KSP Constable result 2026 have to carry the below-mentioned documents at the time of appearing in the physical test.

  • PET/PST Admit Card
  • Educational Qualification Certificate
  • Age/DOB Proof
  • Caste Certificate
  • EWS Certificate
  • Domicile/Residence Certificate
  • Special Category Certificates
  • Valid Photo ID Proof
  • Recent Passport-Size Photographs
  • Original Documents + Self-Attested Photocopies

KSP Constable Result 2026 FAQs

Question: What is the KSP Constable result 2026 date?

Answer: The exam authority has released the result for the written exam on 21st August on the official website.

Question: What is the next stage after the declaration of KSP Constable result 2026?

Answer: Applicants shortlisted based on the result will be called for the physical endurance test.

Question: Do I need to provide any login credentials to check KSP Constable results? 

Answer: Candidates are not required to provide any login credentials to download the result PDF.
